ruleDefinitions.name: Enable Microsoft Dynamic Data Exchange
ruleDefinitions.description: Enable Dynamic Data Exchange protocol (DDE) in all supported editions of Microsoft Word or Excel. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\Word\\\\Security\\\\AllowDDE$") AND (Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000002\)")) OR ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\Excel\\\\Security\\\\DisableDDEServerLaunch$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Excel\\\\Security\\\\DisableDDEServerLookup$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)"))
